turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
very first time?
Yes — for your first use:



Read the warmer instructions and safety info.


If your warmer uses a light bulb, make sure to remove any plastic around the bulb first.


Place the warmer on a safe surface and plug it in.


Add 1–2 bears if you’re using an Outlet or Mini Mod warmer.


Turn it on, or set the built-in timer if your warmer has one.



A good starting point is 2 bears for about 8 hours of scent time.
